DEMO — SYNTHETIC DATA

A complete path.
An honest failed recommendation.

The demo is a deterministic concept preview, not an operating product.

01

Inspect the comparison

Normalize 200 pairs and compare three fictional suppliers with source provenance.

02

Test the limits

03

Review and export

THE BASELINE EXCEPTION

The lower total
does not clear the hold.

The 30-day Juniper quote is cheaper than the 15-day prior purchase. The baseline stays held until a defensible review. Completing the demo does not produce savings or a paid commitment.
